meta.title: Mobilcab — from idea to panel, straight from your browser
meta.description: Cloud-based furniture CAD that runs in your browser, on laptop, tablet or phone. AI design assistant and one-click CNC cutlist export.

hero.title: From idea to panel, straight from your browser.
hero.body: Mobilcab is a cloud-based CAD for furniture — works on laptop, tablet, or phone. No installs, no license servers. Design it, and your cutlist is CNC-ready in one click.
hero.note: The first 100 workshops get Founding Partner pricing, locked for 12 months.

problem.title: Sound familiar?
items: Heavy CAD software installed on one single workshop computer
Expensive licenses for features you barely use
Hours lost manually building the cutlist for your CNC
No easy way to show a live design to a client on-site, from your phone

items.title: 100% browser-based
items.body: No install, no license server. Open it on any device — laptop, tablet, phone.

items.title: AI design assistant
items.body: Suggests panel layouts and flags errors before they reach the saw.

items.title: One-click cutlist & CNC export
items.body: From design to cutting file, no manual steps in between.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.offerDetail: or 549 RON/year, for the Basic plan, locked for 12 months. Only for the first 100 workshops.
pricing.aiNote: Basic covers design and cutlists; you try the AI assistant once, during onboarding. Plans with AI included start at 99 RON/month.
pricing.free: The free plan is available any time.

items.q: Do I need to install anything?
items.a: No, Mobilcab runs straight from your browser.

items.q: Does it work on a tablet?
items.a: Yes, it's built for laptop, tablet and phone.

items.q: Can I export directly for my CNC?
items.a: Yes — the cutlist export is ready for a standard CNC workflow.
The free plan is available any time; the first 100 users get special Founding Partner pricing.
